title: High-Frequency Characterization of Coss Loss and Dynamic RdsON in GaN
venue: 2026 IEEE Applied Power Electronics Conference and Exposition (APEC)
affiliation: Department of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, MIT
status: Accepted — to appear in IEEE Xplore
abstract: A comprehensive experimental characterization of dynamic on-resistance (RdsON) and output-capacitance (Coss) losses for commercial GaN devices under Class-E-type waveforms, measured at duty cycles of 25% and 50%, switching frequencies up to 30 MHz, peak voltages from 200–400 V, and case temperatures up to 80 °C.
